_readme: One entry per launch city. Adding a city = add an entry here + its data files. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude]; bounds are [[west, south], [east, north]]. timezone is the IANA name; utc_offset_minutes (standard time) and dst ('us', 'eu' or none) are the fallback when the system has no time-zone database, as on Windows. boundary is the city's legal outline (GeoJSON); licences, if present, is an open-data list of active food licences that only covers places inside that boundary.
